// note: Thresholds set from real Lighthouse runs (6 Sep 2026), not guesses. Accessibility and best-practices measured 100 on the live site and a local production build; they are the defensible numbers for a recruiter-facing page, so they gate CI. SEO measured 92 only because Lighthouse's own robots.txt fetch times out under the WebGL scene's main-thread load (the file itself returns 200 and is valid) — kept as a warning so a flaky fetch never breaks the build. Performance is intentionally not asserted: a continuously-animating 3D canvas never lets the main thread idle, so TBT/TTI-based scoring is structurally low and is not a meaningful gate here.
